**Building the future of live entertainment** — you're not watching, you're
in it. Living worlds an audience helps shape, piloted into any place: a
venue, a live stream, a home.

Infinite Spaces is a marketplace for living worlds. Creators author participatory experiences in Playbox — worlds an audience helps shape — and run them live in venues, streams, and homes. A two-person crew produces what used to take a full production team.

How images are constructed, frame by frame, from a scene description. The path from data to pixels — geometry, shading, compositing, output. How you build a render pipeline that responds to live input rather than baking everything in advance.

## What You'll Do

What you'll ship in your first 90 days: The render layer — a real-time compositing system that takes World state as input and produces output to an LED wall or projection surface at show cadence.

## What We're Looking For

- GPU and rendering pipeline fluency — knows what's happening on the hardware side of a draw call; comfortable in GLSL/HLSL or WGSL
- Real-time compositing — can layer live video, generative content, and 3D elements together without losing frame rate
- Creative tooling literacy — has worked in at least one of: Unreal, TouchDesigner, Notch, disguise, Unity; understands how production teams actually use these tools on show nights
- Systems thinker — can design a rendering architecture, not just implement one that already exists
- Can reason across the stack: from the scene graph down to the GPU, and from the scene graph up to the authoring surface

Adjacent experience that signals: LED wall workflows, media server integration, virtual production / VP stage experience, broadcast graphics, Houdini, shader graph authoring

## Benefits

- Competitive Seattle salary and meaningful early equity
- Equity-heavy structures available before cash is fully in place, with an honest timeline to when salary normalizes
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- A small team where everyone owns real surface area and your work ships

*You're not watching. You're in it.*
